Move an answer into a gap

Drag an answer to a gap. To change it, drag another answer into the gap. The previous answer returns to the list.

You can also select an answer and then select a gap. Select a filled gap and then the answer list to return it.

Keyboard: focus an answer and press Enter, then focus a gap and press Enter. Press Delete on a filled gap to clear it.
